note: Absolute numbers differ (hardware/dtype/optimizer overhead); only the shape is validated. Per-tensor widths now used (3*d + d_ff). The model defaults flash_attn=True, which zeros the S^2 score-storage term (attn_ws), so that term is UNEXERCISED by default and would need seq>=4096 to become visible. This harness sets flash_attn=False to exercise the score term, but seqs are small (256-1024) so it stays negligible vs the linear residual term; measured growth is roughly linear in seq. The measured activation delta is ~0.5x the model's S^2 score-storage term (torch frees scores during backward), so the activation term is an UPPER BOUND and UNVALIDATED for exact fit; feasibility verdicts at 8B/70B scale are dominated by params/master/opt, not activation.
